description: Verify a signed delivery proof (action-receipt) for a completed purchase. Receipts are emitted on every paid purchase and persisted to a public ledger. Returns what was delivered (skill_id, license_key, amount), the settle txhash, and interop fields for the Vibe action-ref system. Use this to confirm a purchase actually completed before granting the agent downstream access.

receipt_id.description: Receipt ID. Must start with "rcpt_" followed by at least 16 alphanumeric characters (e.g. rcpt_c8b9dc67f88e4da5bd3a).

name: marketnow_verify_receipt
